title: Execution record fields
statement: An execution record is a tuple of eleven natural numbers: the number of circuit inputs, the number of hard-wired bits, the step budget, the current instruction, the cell used by that instruction one step earlier, the first instruction of the current step, the step-loop counter, the inner-loop counter, the position in the hard-wired input, the position in the free input, and a scratch value.
